create_PddlAction: create a PddlAction with a name, parameters, preconditions, and postconditions for PDDL planning
apply_PddlAction_if_true: apply a PddlAction post-condition to the simulator if its pre-condition is satisfied
check_PddlAction_precondition: check if a PddlAction preconditions are satisfied from a list of environment predicates
bind_PddlAction_params: bind PddlAction parameters to PDDL entities and substitute values into pre and post conditions
clone_PddlAction: clone a PddlAction to create a copy with independent preconditions and postconditions
